# Photos

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Symbols:** 60.1% of Apple's iOS API (421 of 700, exact) · **Rows:** 11: 7 ✅ 1 🟡 3 ❌ · **iOS:** 8.0+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Imaging, photos & ML](../COVERAGE.md#ml) · **Apple:** [Photos](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/photos) · **Issues:** [`area:ml`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Aml)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** a simulated photo library in `$ISIM_DATA/Media` (six generated pictures, plus the photos, videos and albums apps save), with the permission alerts.
- **Objective-C / C interface:** `#import <Photos/Photos.h>` and `-framework Photos` (headers in `isim/sdk-src/Frameworks/Photos`) reach the Swift overlay's classes under their Objective-C names, with Apple's selectors (`isim/swift/overlays/Photos/ObjC.swift` for what uses Swift-only types). `PHFetchResult`, `PHFetchResultChangeDetails` and `PHObjectChangeDetails` are Swift generics, so Objective-C has classes of its own (`isim/frameworks/Photos/Photos.m`) over the objects a fetch returned.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Photos (`PHPhotoLibrary`, `PHAsset`, saving images) | 🟡 | ≤17 | device library in `$ISIM_DATA/Media` seeded with 6 generated sample pictures (stand-ins for the Simulator's); permission alert (full / limited with selection / add-only) remembered per app; fetch with sort/limit and predicates (`mediaType`, `creationDate`, `favorite`, `pixelWidth`, …), smart albums (Recents, Favorites, Videos), `PHImageManager` scaling, `PHAssetChangeRequest` create/favorite/delete (with confirmation), change observers; Live Photos and edits (rows below) |
| Photos' Objective-C interface: `Photos.h` and the class headers (`PHPhotoLibrary.h`, `PHAsset.h`, `PHCollection.h`, `PHFetchResult.h`, `PHFetchOptions.h`, `PHChange.h`, `PHImageManager.h`, `PHAssetChangeRequest.h`, `PHAssetCollectionChangeRequest.h`, `PHAssetResource.h`, `PHAssetResourceManager.h`, `PHError.h`, `PhotosTypes.h`), the enums, `PHImage…Key`, `PHImageManagerMaximumSize`, `PHPhotosErrorDomain`, `PHLocalIdentifierNotFound`, `PHPhotoLibraryChangeObserver` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the Swift classes under their Objective-C names (`OBJC_NAMES` keeps their old class symbols); Objective-C's `PHFetchResult` holds the objects of the fetch (indexing, `NSFastEnumeration`, block enumeration, `countOfAssetsWithMediaType:`) and runs it again for `-[PHChange changeDetailsForFetchResult:]`, whose inserted, removed and changed indexes compare the two (no moves); change requests take an `NSArray` or a `PHFetchResult`; the Live Photo and editing classes (`PHLivePhoto.h`, `PHContentEditing.h`, `PHAdjustmentData.h`, `PHContentEditingInput.h`, `PHContentEditingOutput.h`, `PHLivePhotoRequestOptions`, `requestLivePhotoForAsset:…`, `requestContentEditingInputWithOptions:completionHandler:`, `contentEditingOutput`, `PHAssetPlaybackStyle`, the `PHContentEditingInput…Key` and `PHLivePhotoInfo…Key` constants); no `PHCollectionList` or persistent changes; the classes are not subclassable from Objective-C. Tested (tests/photos-objc: fetches, image and data requests, resources, saving into a new album, favourites, a change observer) |
| Videos: `PHAssetChangeRequest.creationRequestForAssetFromVideo(atFileURL:)`, `PHAssetCreationRequest` `.video` resources, `PHImageManager.requestAVAsset(forVideo:options:resultHandler:)`, `requestPlayerItem(forVideo:options:resultHandler:)`, `requestExportSession(forVideo:options:exportPreset:resultHandler:)`, `PHVideoRequestOptions` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: movies are copied into the library with a poster frame (as `UISaveVideoAtPathToSavedPhotosAlbum` does), with their duration and size; requests give an `AVURLAsset` / `AVPlayerItem` / `AVAssetExportSession` over the library file on a background queue; isim keeps one version of each video, so `version`, `deliveryMode` and network access change nothing; no `AVAudioMix`; tested (HelloPhotos, test_photos_videos_albums) |
| Albums: `PHAssetCollectionChangeRequest` (`creationRequestForAssetCollection(withTitle:)`, `init(for:)`, `init(for:assets:)`, `title`, `addAssets`, `insertAssets(_:at:)`, `removeAssets`, `removeAssets(at:)`, `replaceAssets(at:withAssets:)`, `moveAssets(at:to:)`, `deleteAssetCollections`), `PHAssetCollection.fetchAssetCollections(with: .album …)`, `fetchAssetCollectionsContaining(_:with:options:)`, `PHCollection.fetchTopLevelUserCollections(with:)`, `canPerform(_:)` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: user albums kept in the library index, in their own order; fetch predicates and sorting on `title` / `localizedTitle`; the asset arguments take an `NSArray`, a `PHFetchResult` or placeholders (typed `Any`, where Apple's are `NSFastEnumeration`); no folders (`PHCollectionList`) or shared albums; tested (HelloPhotos, test_photos_videos_albums) |
| Resources: `PHAssetResource.assetResources(for:)`, `PHAssetResourceManager` (`requestData(for:options:dataReceivedHandler:completionHandler:)`, `writeData(for:toFile:options:)`, `cancelDataRequest`), `PHAssetResourceRequestOptions` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: each asset has one resource, its photo or video file (`.photo` / `.video`, with its type identifier); data comes in chunks on a background queue; `writeData` fails when the file exists, as on iOS; tested (HelloPhotos, test_photos_videos_albums) |
| Live Photos: `PHLivePhoto` (`size`, `request(withResourceFileURLs:placeholderImage:targetSize:contentMode:resultHandler:)`, `cancelRequest(withRequestID:)`, `NSSecureCoding`, `NSItemProviderReading` in PhotosUI), `PHLivePhotoRequestOptions`, `PHImageManager.requestLivePhoto(for:targetSize:contentMode:options:resultHandler:)`, `PHAssetCreationRequest` `.photo` + `.pairedVideo`, `PHAsset.playbackStyle`, `PHAssetMediaSubtype.photoLive`, the paired resource types | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: a Live Photo is a library still with its movie kept beside it (`IMG_0007.JPG`, `IMG_0007.MOV`), reported as `photoLive` / `.livePhoto` with `.photo` and `.pairedVideo` resources; requests answer on the main queue (a placeholder first, degraded, when one is given); no Live Photo editing (`PHLivePhotoEditingContext`); tested (HelloPhotos, test_photos_live_edits) |
| Editing: `PHContentEditingInput` (`mediaType`, `mediaSubtypes`, `creationDate`, `location`, `uniformTypeIdentifier`, `contentType`, `playbackStyle`, `adjustmentData`, `displaySizeImage`, `fullSizeImageURL`, `fullSizeImageOrientation`, `audiovisualAsset`, `livePhoto`), `PHContentEditingOutput` (`init(contentEditingInput:)`, `init(placeholderForCreatedAsset:)`, `adjustmentData`, `renderedContentURL`, `renderedContentURL(for:)`, `defaultRenderedContentType`, `supportedRenderedContentTypes`), `PHAdjustmentData`, `PHContentEditingInputRequestOptions`, `PHAsset.requestContentEditingInput(with:completionHandler:)`, `cancelContentEditingInputRequest`, `hasAdjustments`, `PHAssetChangeRequest.contentEditingOutput`, `revertAssetContentToOriginal()` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: an edit keeps the original and stores the rendered file (`IMG_0007_E.JPG`) and the adjustment data in the library; the current version shows the edit, `.original` / `.unadjusted` requests the original; the input is the original when `canHandleAdjustmentData` accepts the adjustments (with them), else the edit; edited assets list `.fullSizePhoto` and `.adjustmentData` resources; reverting removes the edit; tested (HelloPhotos, test_photos_live_edits) |
| `UIImageWriteToSavedPhotosAlbum` | ✅ | ≤17 | add-only permission alert, completion selector called with nil/error |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `PHCollectionList`, `PHLivePhoto`, `PHLivePhotoRequestOptions` (3 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 26) | ❌ | 26.1 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `PHAssetResourceUploadJob`, `PHAssetResourceUploadJobChangeRequest`, `PHBackgroundResourceUploadExtension` (3 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 27) | ❌ | 27.0 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `PHAssetExtendedMetadata`, `PHAssetResourceUploadJobOptions`, `PHBackgroundResourceUploadJobExtension`, `PHPhotoLibraryPersistentChangesObserver`, `PHReferenceImageInfo` (5 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
